paxNotes.text: 2–3 pax: MPV 7-seater — ruang bagasi paling terhad, nasihat 1 luggage besar + 1 hand carry seorang
15 pax ke atas: katalog hanya beri harga sehingga 14 pax. Kadar extension & airport transfer di luar band akan papar kadar belum diisi — quote manual dengan operator.

validity: Validity of Quotation: All prices are valid for 24 hours after quotation submission and are subject to hotel and room availability as no space has been secured. Price is based on 2–3 persons per room and covers Ground & Tipping only — international flight tickets are not included. A deposit of RM 500 per pax is required upon confirmation, with full payment due 45 days prior to arrival. A late booking surcharge of RM 50 per booking applies for bookings made less than 45 days before departure. Private transportation and tour guide are based on a 10 hour basis; every extra hour is chargeable at RM 160 per hour and must be paid in cash on the ground. Fare is not applicable during peak seasons; please refer to the peak season surcharge. Blackout dates: Chinese New Year 14–22 February 2026 and Labor Day 1–5 May 2026. Final itinerary and hotel arrangements will be confirmed at least 15 days before the trip. Itinerary, price and flight schedule are subject to change. This package is valid for travel until 31 December 2026.
